arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
work=$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-telegram-optin.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf -- "$work"' EXIT
git clone -q --depth 1 --branch feat/official-optin-approval-20261031 https://github.com/martaxi-boss/telegram-robot-leads.git "$work"
cd "$work"
git --no-pager log -1 --format='CANDIDATE_SHA=%H'
git --no-pager diff --check HEAD
sudo -n -H /opt/telegram-robot-leads/.venv/bin/python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -q
sudo -n -H /usr/bin/python3 -B -c 'import ast; from pathlib import Path; p=Path("scripts/organic_growth.py"); ast.parse(p.read_text()); print("OPTIN_SOURCE_AST_PASS")'
node --check ecosystem.config.js
echo OPTIN_CANDIDATE_VALIDATED
